title: Online banking transfers
goal: Show customer banking services and the reusable controls around a funds transfer.

rubric.must: A subject boundary labelled Retail Banking Portal visibly contains the banking use cases.
Dashed open-arrow «include» relationships from Transfer Funds visibly point to Authenticate Customer, Validate Payee, and Approve Transfer.
Review Suspicious Transfer has a dashed open-arrow «extend» relationship pointing to Transfer Funds and references its suspicious transfer extension point.
Customer is a stick-figure actor while Core Banking and Fraud Service are visibly external-system actors.
Premium Customer generalizes to Customer with a hollow triangle pointing to Customer.

ideal.notes: Drafted by Codex from the source and the rubric, without seeing the engine's own output. It preferred the svg: The SVG satisfies all five rules, while the picture fails both blockers and omits several required actors and extension details.
